sentences.text:
Mr. V. S. Badakh, Agp for the appellants/State
 Mr. R. P. Dhase, Advocate for the respondent Nos.1 and 2
 Coram : Rajnish R. Vyas, J.

Date : 03rd February, 2026
 Per Court :
 1.

This is an appeal preferred by the acquiring body  challenging the award passed by the Civil Judge Senior Division,
 Osmanabad in LAR No. 221/2006 dated 09-01-2012.
First challenge  is to the quantum of the compensation awarded to the claimant and  second challenge is the date from which the interest was awarded by  the reference court.
2. Mr. Badakh, learned AGP for the acquiring body  submitted that while determining the compensation what was taken  into consideration by the reference court was a sale deed at Exh.22.

He submitted that sale deed at Exh.22 was dated 09-08-1984 of land  situated in village Jagji whereas the notification under section 4 of The State Of Maharashtra And Others vs Suresh Dattatray Puranik And Another on 3 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108011041/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: the Land Acquisition Act was issued in the year 1994.

He, thus,
submitted that the said course should not have been adopted.
According to him, Exh.22 was the sale deed of irrigated land, which was sold @ Rs.75,000/- per Acre, in the year 1984, whereas the land in present case is concerned, it was not irrigated land.

He submitted that before determining the compensation on the basis of Exh.22, the reference court ought to have taken into consideration the fact that the land acquired of the claimant was not irrigated land and it was a dry crop land.
3. I have gone through the record of the case.

The reference court while coming to the conclusion that the land acquired was irrigated land has taken into consideration the fact that there was a entry of well in 7/12 extract of the acquired land and further the claimants were getting crops like Hybrid, Tur, Rice/Sal, Sunflower Groundnut & Soyabin.
Mr. Badakh, submitted that 7/12 extract cannot be relied upon as it was of the year of 2009-2010.
4. Learned Advocate for the claimant submitted that it is undisputed position that there is entry of well in 7/12 extract and therefore, land was irrigated land.
He has also stated in the evidence that he was taking crops of sugarcane and grapes.
In the cross- examination conducted nothing fruitful was brought on record to disbelieve the testimony of the said witness.

Apart from it, reference  2 of 4 The State Of Maharashtra And Others vs Suresh Dattatray Puranik And Another on 3 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108011041/
2  (3) 901fa123.18

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: court has taken into consideration Exh.22 which was of the year 1984 i.e. 10 years prior to the notification issued under section 4 and thereafter, determined the market value without giving any annual increase.
In that view of the matter, I do not find find any error committed by the reference court by considering the Exh.27 and determining the compensation @ Rs.75,000/-per Acre.
5. Coming to the second point regarding the grant of interest from the date of notification.
Both the learned counsels

fairly submitted that issue is no more res integra in view of the judgment of State of Maharashtra Vs Kailash Shiva Rangari reported in 2016 (3)
Mh.L.J. 457.

entities.text:
State of Maharashtra Vs Kailash Shiva Rangari reported in 2016 (3)
Mh.L.J. 457
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: They submitted that interest is required to be awarded from the date of award and not from the date of notification under section 4, since urgency clause was not invoked.
6. Learned Advocate for the claimant submitted that since possession was already taken before the issuance of notification under section 4, he is entitled for rental compensation.
He may be right, but this court while deciding the appeal filed by the acquiring body, cannot decide the question of grant of rental compensation.
Needless to mention that the claimant can always request the competent authority for claiming the rental compensation and adjustment of the interest amount.

In that view of the matter following order is passed:

3  ORDER

entities.text: State Of Maharashtra And Others vs Suresh Dattatray Puranik And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: a ] The appeal is partly allowed.
b] The claimant shall be entitled for the interest in accordance with law, from the date of award and not from the date of notification issued under section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act.
Other part of award passed by the reference court is maintained.
c] The appeal is disposed off.
